kind: engineering development exercise (development evidence only; no scientific claim)

dataset.name: AdK open-start MD (Oradd & Andersson 2021)
dataset.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record), as recorded in benchmarks/audit/adk_feasibility/results/adk_g0_provenance.json
dataset.access_record: WP-B G0 download authorization and provenance (adk_g0_provenance.json, g0_passed = true)

frame_subset.rule: every third source frame from frame 0; deterministic

expected_consistency_checks: source SHA-256 values equal the G0 record
214 residues, resids 1-214 consecutive, all with a Calpha; one segment
751 frames with source indices 0, 3, ..., 2250 and time = 200 ps x source index
source length unit nm converted to Angstrom by MDAnalysis
frame identity reported as not_verifiable (XTC stores no per-frame atom identity)
no non-finite coordinates or valid features
geometric breaks after make_whole: expected 0; any occurrence is reported with frames
kappa valid cells expected 751 x 212, tau valid 751 x 211 unless degenerate geometry or breaks; any shortfall explained

resource_cap.note: engineering budget, not a performance target
